rows.name: Jer'Zhan Newton
rows.comment: The Commanders designated Newton (pectoral) for return to practice from their injured reserve list Wednesday.

rows.name: Marcus Mariota
rows.comment: Mariota (knee) was a full participant in Wednesday's practice.

rows.name: Antonio Williams
rows.comment: Coach Dan Quinn noted Monday that with Terry McLaurin (knee) out for the season, Stefon Diggs' workload isn't expected to change much, however others, notably Williams, should see added opportunities in McLaurin's looming absence, Nicki Jhabvala of The Athletic reports.

rows.name: Jaylin Lane
rows.comment: Lane underwent surgery Oct. 9 to repair his fractured and dislocated ankle, and he is expected to be cleared for activities before OTAs, Tashan Reed of The Washington Post reports.

rows.name: Sonny Styles
rows.comment: Styles finished Monday's 23-17 loss to the 49ers with 13 tackles (seven solo) and one pass defense.

rows.name: Drew Stevens
rows.comment: Stevens made his only field-goal try and converted both of his extra-point attempts during Monday's 23-17 loss at San Francisco.

rows.name: Austin Ekeler
rows.comment: Ekeler logged a three-yard carry and caught both of his targets for four yards during the Commanders' 23-17 loss to the 49ers on Monday.

rows.name: Dyami Brown
rows.comment: Brown hauled in his only target for six yards during Monday's 23-17 loss versus San Francisco.

rows.name: Jeremy McNichols
rows.comment: McNichols accrued five rushes for 13 yards during Monday's 23-17 loss to the 49ers.

rows.name: Charles Omenihu
rows.comment: questionable

rows.name: Chig Okonkwo
rows.comment: Okonkwo brought in all seven targets for 69 yards in the Commanders' 23-17 loss to the 49ers on Monday night.

rows.name: Rachaad White
rows.comment: White rushed seven times for 27 yards and brought in four of five targets for 30 yards and a touchdown in the Commanders' 23-17 loss to the 49ers on Monday night.

rows.name: Jayden Daniels
rows.comment: Daniels completed 29 of 40 passes for 300 yards with two touchdowns and no interceptions while adding four rushes for 10 yards in the Commanders' 23-17 loss to the 49ers on Monday night.
